scope.contract: Original immutable I-005 and s3 ripple-trim row: first apply the trim, compute duration difference Δ, and shift items after the edit boundary on participating tracks by Δ; in trim pins timelineStart at the old value. This slice opens both shortening and lengthening on the existing RippleTrimClip command. Insert-mode MoveClips is unchanged and still leaves the source as a gap; no new MoveClips mode is added. Leave-gap TrimClip, video-only TrimClip(ripple:true), clip-id and range RippleDeleteClips, and reject/overwrite/insert stay distinct. Auto-close-on-move, new-track creation, cross-project bake and the OS clipboard are not implemented. I-006 roll/slip/slide and the full trim planner remain unopened.
scope.temporalSemantics: Δ is out.delta, or -in.delta when the in edge is pinned. Shorten (Δ<0) still closes the vacated tail R=[oldEnd+Δ, oldEnd). Lengthen (Δ>0) grows the selected closure into [oldEnd, oldEnd+Δ), splits other participating items at oldEnd, and shifts later items by +Δ. Sequence duration changes by Δ, but not below later ends on unmoved non-ripple tracks. Assets are kept. Remnants are not auto-joined. Source start < 0 or source past the stream duration refuses SOURCE_OUT_OF_RANGE. Over-shorten still CLIP_TOO_SHORT. Insert-move still leaves a source gap until an explicit range close is used.
scope.preserved: Link closure is complete (includeLinks=true). Source time, cropped or extended opacity curves, static effects, proxy/asset version refs and audio offsets are preserved. Locks on a written field raise FIELD_LOCKED. A locked syncLock non-target that would have to crop or shift raises SYNC_LOCKED. Whole-group atomic refusal, never a silent subset. For shorten, transitions whose cut is strictly inside the vacated tail are dropped; later cuts remap and subtract |Δ|. For lengthen, cuts at or after oldEnd remap and add Δ; no cuts are dropped only because they sat in the opened interval. Absolute captions that would have to crop or shift (cue end > affected start) refuse CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; caption cue-follow/anchor policy is not opened.
scope.history: Each ripple trim (shorten or lengthen) is one existing persistent command with snapshot undo/redo, save/reopen, archive fork and AAC MP4 export. No new persistence schema or fingerprint side branch.
scope.ui: Workbench keeps Ripple trim out/in for shortening and adds Ripple trim out lengthen (key ripple-trim-out-lengthen) and Ripple trim in lengthen (key ripple-trim-in-lengthen) using the existing positive-frames field. Existing Key(trim) is unchanged and still leave-gap when persistent audio is present. UI tests jump foundation-scroll and do not drag through the pointer timeline.
